payload.summary: Recovered ri-06 planning closes the historical stale checkpoint and multi-member resume blockers before implementation.

decisions.title: Use a shared checkpoint transaction for authority
decisions.rationale: It prevents stale whole-snapshot writes without holding the lock during approval-service waiting.

decisions.title: Apply only the current unapplied batch cohort
decisions.rationale: It preserves initial exactness and enables fresh results for resumed members after peers complete.

next_steps: Run a fresh vendor plan review when dispatcher collection is repaired, then begin TDD implementation.
